passage.title: Original synthetic reading fixture
passage.text: The library put seed packets near its entrance. Visitors could take one packet and leave seeds from their own gardens later. The first week, only three people joined. By autumn, neighbors were swapping advice beside the seed shelf. The librarian decided to reserve a corner for gardening books.

cases.question: What is a main idea of the passage? Explain with a detail.
cases.response: A seed exchange helped neighbors share knowledge as well as seeds. People started swapping advice.
cases.follow_up: Would mentioning that only three joined at first strengthen my explanation?
review_notes: Accept the supported synthesis; discuss the detail rather than inventing attendance numbers.

passage.title: Original synthetic reading fixture
passage.text: Before lunch, Omar moved his chair away from the hedge. Birds landed on the hedge after he sat beside the tree. He stopped talking and watched them until the bell rang.

cases.question: Suggest why the birds landed after Omar moved. Explain the uncertainty.
cases.response: They may have felt safer with him farther away. He moved away from the hedge before they landed.
cases.follow_up: Another possibility is that being quiet helped. The passage does not prove either cause.
review_notes: Accept supported possibilities; avoid falsely claiming one proven cause or rejecting acknowledged ambiguity.
